result.summary: Found several issues including a critical broken delivery fee display (NaN), truncated restaurant names, and minor layout/styling problems on the food delivery home screen.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows delivery fee as '€NaN delivery', indicating a null/undefined price failed to format correctly.
issues.suggestion: Handle missing or invalid delivery fee values with a fallback (e.g. 'Free', '—', or hide the fee) and fix the data/formatting so NaN never appears to users.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated in the Fastest near you carousel card.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on detail view so names are not cut off mid-word.

issues.description: Category filter chips row ends with a partially visible empty/white chip on the right, looking like incomplete UI rather than intentional scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure only real categories render, add proper peek of the next labeled chip, or pad the scroll end so empty placeholders are not shown.

issues.description: Promo banner code and min. order text is dense and may wrap awkwardly on smaller widths; secondary line is long relative to the card.
issues.suggestion: Tighten copy or allow clearer line breaks so the offer remains scannable on all phone sizes.
